sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: The core gameplay mechanics of Mahjong Connect are simple yet engaging. Your goal is to remove tiles by matching them in a limited time. You can play with 40 different mahjong tiles, each with its unique design and color scheme. The game offers two different boards, each with its own layout and challenges. To remove tiles, you need to match them by connecting tiles that are adjacent to each other, either horizontally or vertically. The twist is that you can only connect tiles with a maximum of three straight lines, and the line cannot go through any other tile. This mechanic adds a layer of complexity to the game, making it more challenging and exciting. As you progress through the levels, the tiles will be randomly arranged, requiring you to think strategically and plan ahead. With each level, the time limit will decrease, making the game more pressure-filled and exciting. To remove tiles, you need to select a tile, and then try to match it with another tile that is similar. If the tiles match, both tiles will disappear, and you'll earn points for each level cleared. The game becomes more challenging as you progress through the levels, requiring you to think strategically, plan ahead, and react quickly to the changing tile arrangements.
